description: Append an episode to an agent's journal (what it did + outcome) — the raw material `reflect` learns from. Required: agent_id, summary. Optional: outcome ('success'|'partial'|'failure'|'abandoned'), brain_id, goal_id, actions (object), prediction (what you expected BEFORE acting) and confidence (0..1, how likely you thought success was). Give both: the difference between them and what happened is the surprise, and reflection reads the surprising episodes first — an episode that went as expected teaches nothing. Without confidence no surprise is computed and the episode ranks last.

actions.description: Structured details of the actions taken

confidence.description: How likely you thought success was before acting, 0..1

outcome.description: Result: success, partial, failure or abandoned

summary.description: What the agent did in this episode

name: log_episode
